description: Side-by-side distribution summary for 2 to 10 covered ETFs (54 tickers seeded): per ticker, frequency, latest distribution, trailing-4 and trailing-12 averages, history count and annualized distribution per share — summary fields only. An uncovered ticker is refused free (400) before payment. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/etf/compare.
